log.steam_method_unavailable: {method} does not exist in this version of Steam — skipping
qa.backup_location_desc: The card always carries the saves. The cloud is a backup and costs waiting on the network.
qa.badge_pos_desc: Green = card in the reader, white = no card. Other plugins draw on tiles too — pick a free corner.
qa.cloud_missing: cloud: MISSING — nothing will sync (set it up in Ludusavi)
qa.game_page_pos_desc: Where to show save status next to the PLAY button. You share this screen with other plugins — pick a spot that does not collide.
qa.lang_desc: Follows the Steam interface language by default.
qa.patch_failure: Could not add the section to the game screen — Steam changed the layout. Actions are still available in “Open game list”.
qa.sgdb_key_desc_missing: no key: games get added without artwork
qa.sgdb_key_desc_stored: a key is already saved — typing a new one overwrites it
qa.sgdb_key_not_saved: the backend did NOT save the key — expand “Events” in this panel
qa.sync_busy: Sync is already running (triggered by an event) — wait a moment.
qa.toast_conflict_body: {games} — resolve it in NonSteam Sync → “Open game list”.
qa.toast_push_conflict_body: {title}: the cloud has drifted from the local state — resolve it in NonSteam Sync → “Open game list”.
qa.toast_push_failed_body: {title}: saves did NOT reach the cloud{detail}. See details in “Events” in the NonSteam Sync panel.
qa.toast_push_ok_body: {title}'s saves were uploaded to the cloud.
stage.kopia_do_chmury: Uploading the copy to the cloud…
stage.kopia_na_karte: Saving a copy to the card…
status.ludusavi_unknown: Ludusavi does not know this title — no save support
status.no_file_on_disk: game file is missing from the drive
status.not_on_card: game is not on the card — the tile can be removed
ui.action_failed: the action did not go through
ui.actions.fix: If the plugin got it wrong
ui.appid_not_saved: appid {appid} was not saved in the registry: {detail}
ui.appid_not_saved_reverted: appid {appid} was not saved in the registry (tile reverted): {detail}
ui.archive_failed: could not archive the save to the card
ui.artwork_done_note: artwork downloaded — the library tile will refresh itself
ui.artwork_no_image: backend did not return an image
ui.artwork_no_tile: the game has no tile, there is nothing to decorate
ui.collection_dynamic: collection “{name}” is dynamic — it cannot be edited
ui.collections_list_failed: card collections: could not fetch the game list: {detail}
ui.conflict.send_mine_desc: what is in the game — to the card first, then the cloud
ui.conflict.take_card_desc: the copy the card carried from the other device
ui.conflict_banner.desc: The three copies of this game have diverged. Choose which one to keep — the others will be overwritten. A safety backup is made automatically before overwriting.
ui.conflict_banner.heading: SAVE CONFLICT
ui.disk_panel_desc: The scan only sees games on cards. Point to a game installed on the drive yourself — its saves will be kept in a backup on the drive, and the cloud will carry them between devices.
ui.exe_set_note: pointed to {path} — the tile now uses this file
ui.forget_force_log: {title}: tile removed WITHOUT archiving the save — the save stayed only in this device's prefix
ui.forget_force_note: tile removed; the save was NOT archived to the card
ui.forget_note.had_saves: the save and playtime stayed on the card — they will return on the next scan
ui.forget_note.no_saves: the game had no saves; playtime stayed on the card
ui.fresh_sync_failed: could not ask the card for the added games' saves: {detail}
ui.hltb.label: Time to beat
ui.hltb.missing: HowLongToBeat does not know this game
ui.label.forget_force: removing the tile without archiving the save
ui.label.take_card: taking the save from the card
ui.meta.missing: The Steam store does not know this game — there is no description to get.
ui.no_games_desc: Add games with the “Scan SD card” button in the NonSteam Sync panel. If you already did that, the reason should be in the event log.
ui.page.sync_failed: The sync did not go through — see “Events”.
ui.patch_anchor_missing: could not recognize the game screen content block (Steam changed the layout)
ui.patch_slot_missing: could not find a slot for the section (Steam changed the game screen layout)
ui.pick_exe_no_card: this game's card is not in the reader — insert it, then you can pick the file
ui.players.label: Online
ui.registry_no_entry: the registry did not return an entry
ui.registry_release_failed: the registry did not release the game
ui.retitle_intro: The title is the game's identity: it decides where its saves live and what the tile is called. Pick from the Ludusavi database — a hand-typed title the database does not know means a game with no save handling.
ui.retitle_no_card: {title}: this game's card is not in the reader, so the save folder on it cannot be renamed.
ui.scan_note_empty: the card returned no games at all (is it inserted?)
ui.scan_note_failed: the scan ended with an error
ui.steam_card.desc: Release date, score, game modes and Valve hardware compatibility on a Steam game's screen. The plugin does not touch those games' saves.
ui.steam_card.label: The card on Steam games too
ui.steam_card.off: Only my games from a card
ui.steam_no_appid: Steam did not assign an appid for the shortcut
ui.storepick_clear: Go back to the database match
ui.storepick_cleared: The description comes from the Ludusavi database game again.
ui.storepick_found: Found in the store — pick the right game:
ui.storepick_intro: The description, score and compatibility come from the Steam store game the Ludusavi database points at. When it points at the wrong edition (or at nothing), pick the game yourself.
ui.storepick_none: The Steam store found nothing for {wanted}.
ui.storepick_title: Match the game in the Steam store
ui.summary.adopted: adopted existing tiles: {count} (their saves stay yours)
ui.summary.already_in_library: {count} already had a tile in the library

ui.summary.ambiguous.one: {count} game has several existing tiles — I will not guess which one holds your progress: {list}
ui.summary.ambiguous.other: {count} games have several existing tiles — I will not guess which one holds your progress: {list}

ui.summary.gone_from_card.one: {count} game is no longer on the card ({list}) — NonSteam Sync shows “stop managing” for it, the save stays on the card
ui.summary.gone_from_card.other: {count} games are no longer on the card ({list}) — NonSteam Sync shows “stop managing” for it, the save stays on the card

ui.summary.need_title: {count} without a recognized title ({list}) — finish it in NonSteam Sync → “Unrecognized games”
ui.sync_note.blocked: the game is running — saves untouched
ui.sync_note.unchanged: no changes: local saves are up to date
ui.tile_path_refresh_failed: {title}: could not refresh the tile path: {detail}
ui.unnamed.added_ok: added “{title}” — check the tile in your library
ui.unnamed.added_renamed: added as “{title}” — that is what Ludusavi calls this game (saves depend on that name)
ui.unnamed.added_unknown: added “{title}”, but Ludusavi does NOT know this title — this game's saves will not be supported. Try another name (e.g. from the Steam store).
ui.unnamed.all_recognized: Games on the card: {total} — each with a recognized title. Nothing to do here.
ui.unnamed.empty_title: empty title — Ludusavi would have nothing to search for
ui.unnamed.found_label: Found in the database — pick the right one:
ui.unnamed.found_none: The database does not know this title. You can add the game under the typed name, but its saves will not be supported until the title matches the database.
ui.unnamed.intro: Ludusavi recognizes a title from the folder name. When it fails, the game cannot be added, because without a canonical title there is no way to find its saves. Enter the title by hand — ideally exactly as the game is named in the store.
ui.unnamed.no_proposals: Ludusavi has no suggestion for this name — enter the title yourself.
ui.unnamed.not_found: the Ludusavi database does not know anything under “{wanted}” — without a match this game will not have save support
ui.unnamed.scan_empty: The scan returned NO game at all — is the card inserted? If it is, the reason will be in “Events” in the NonSteam Sync panel.
ui.unnamed.search_label: Search for a title in the Ludusavi database
ui.unnamed.title: Unrecognized games
ui.unnamed.type_first: enter part of the title first
